alt: 孩子將掉落的蘋果交還鄰居，微笑擺手回應對方的感謝。
scene_prompt: Beside a dropped grocery bag, a child has just picked up one fallen apple and hands it back to a grateful older neighbor. The neighbor smiles thanks while the child modestly waves their free hand with a gentle humble smile as if this small favor is hardly worth mentioning. Only one apple being exchanged, anatomically clear hands.
